messages:
Jordan M.: Heads-up — planning deploy of release/infra v2.14 to prod at 2024-06-04 15:00 UTC (~45m). Canary at 10% for first 5m. Asking for smoke owners + rollback readiness check. Rollback triggers: error rate >2% OR p95 latency >600ms sustained 2m OR canary alert. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-v2.14
Priya N.: I can own smoke + synthetics. Will run the quick suite and the end-to-end checkout flow at T+0 and T+5m. My dashboards: /dashboards/smoke-prod
Alex K.: CRs are merged. DB migration is additive (adds nullable column) — no blocking migration. Note: there is a feature toggle for the new routing logic, default off. We'll enable in rollout to speed rollback if needed.
Samir P.: I'll be on rollback duty and reachable. If we need to revert, I'm prepared to cut traffic and trigger rollback. How do we invoke rollback from CLI? @release-bot?
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.14 -> prod. Canary: 10% for 5m. Commands:
```
# promote/rollback examples
release-bot promote --from canary --to prod
release-bot rollback --to v2.13
```
SRE Oncall: I'll watch infra signals (CPU, queue lengths, pod restarts) and ES latency. FYI — autoscaler will add nodes but may take ~90s; if we see queuing spike, that's a soft-trigger to consider rollback.
Priya N.: Smoke checklist (short):
- user login flow ✅
- embeddings endpoint basic perf ✅
- background job worker catches up within 30s
If any fail, call rollback.
Jordan M.: Quick checklist before T-10m: everyone ack that they can action rollback, links to runbook + rollback command, and who owns canary monitors. React with :thumbsup: when set.
Alex K.: Ack. I'll monitor slow queries and feature toggle. :thumbsup:
Priya N.: Ack and will post smoke results in thread. :thumbsup:
Samir P.: Ack and oncall ready. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: Ack. Alerts configured for p95 and error spikes. :thumbsup:
(15:00 UTC) release-bot: Canary deploy started — v2.14 at 10% traffic.
Priya N.: Running smoke now (T+1m). First pass green except one 502 from embeddings at 14:59:32 — investigating.
Alex K.: saw the 502, looks like a transient backend timeout; increasing retries on client side now.
Priya N.: Second pass (T+3m) — all smoke checks green. No increase in errors on canary.
SRE Oncall: infra metrics steady. p95 latency 320ms, error rate 0.4% for canary.
Jordan M.: Canary healthy at 10% for 5m. Proceeding to 50% for 3m, then full if green. If anyone sees >2% errors or p95 >600ms, call rollback immediately.
(15:09 UTC) release-bot: Traffic bumped to 50%.
Priya N.: Monitoring — heatmaps look normal. No alerts.
Samir P.: Ready to execute rollback if asked. Rollback command example below saved in runbook:
```
# emergency rollback
release-bot rollback --to v2.13 --reason "canary-failure"
```
Jordan M.: Alright — 50% stable. Pushing to 100% in 2m unless objections.
Alex K.: No objections, :thumbsup:
Priya N.: :thumbsup: smoke green
(15:14 UTC) release-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. v2.14 now serving prod traffic.
Priya N.: Final smoke liveness checks done — all green. I'll close out with a short postmortem if anything pops in the next hour.
Jordan M.: Thanks everyone. If anything regresses, reopen thread and call rollback. Closing this thread but keeping runbook pinned. :white_check_mark:
